svg.title: Strategic Machines platform architecture
svg.desc: Three-layer platform: Studio (customer-facing configuration), Orchestration (Vercel Workflows plus agent runtime), and Infrastructure (voice providers, telephony, integrations).

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Design the agent builder UI for Strategic Machines')
sendPrompt('What skills and tools should voice agents support in the platform?')
sendPrompt('How should tool / API configuration work in the agent studio?')
sendPrompt('What analytics and monitoring should be in the voice agent dashboard?')

g.text: Durable execution, state, and agent runtime

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should Vercel Workflows power the agent orchestration layer?')
sendPrompt('How does agent memory and context work across calls?')
sendPrompt('How should multi-tenant routing and isolation work for voice agents?')
sendPrompt('How should human escalation and HITL work in the platform?')
sendPrompt('What is the recommended voice provider strategy for Strategic Machines?')
sendPrompt('What telephony providers should Strategic Machines support?')
sendPrompt('What CRM and business integrations should the platform support?')
sendPrompt('How should compliance, audit logging and security work in the platform?')

svg.text: Each layer exposes its own API — Studio for customers, Orchestration for agents, Infrastructure for DevOps
